subject.title: fix(volcengine): normalize escape sequences in tool call arguments

question: Should OpenClaw accept any provider-wide rewrite of arbitrary DeepSeek/Volcengine tool arguments, or require a raw failing transport example and a narrowly proven argument contract first?
rationale: The linked report concerns write content, but the patch changes every tool argument for a model-prefix family; source evidence does not establish whether the transport defect is universal or which argument values may safely be transformed.

options.title: Require contract-scoped repair
options.body: Keep the PR open until it includes a redacted failing raw argument and limits repair to the confirmed protocol or tool-argument contract.

options.title: Accept provider-wide normalization
options.body: Accept the broader heuristic only after maintainers explicitly choose its compatibility tradeoff and require regression proof for non-write tool arguments.

recommendation.title: Require contract-scoped repair
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until it includes a redacted failing raw argument and limits repair to the confirmed protocol or tool-argument contract.
